_about: New-document family (1 Nov 2026): questions answered by a library document that is not a budget, without naming it (the EmONC assessment, the 2025 Sokoto MPI report, the 2025 health sector AOP), so the library-wide search, not the plan, must find it. Expected values in questions_checks.json were read from the PDF text of the page named. Part of the pre-deploy gate: uv run python evals/complex/run_open.py --file evals/newdocs/questions.json --out evals/newdocs/report.md

questions.text: How many emergency obstetric and newborn care facilities does Sokoto have, and what share of them are basic (BEmONC) facilities?
What share of Sokoto's emergency obstetric care facilities reported power cuts lasting more than 30 minutes?
How many people in Sokoto live within 30 minutes of a functional emergency obstetric care facility?
Mutane nawa ne a jihar Sokoto ke zaune a cikin minti 30 daga cibiyar kula da gaggawar haihuwa da jarirai mai aiki?
How many eligible public health facilities were identified for Sokoto's emergency obstetric care assessment, and how many of them were assessed?
What share of Sokoto State's GDP came from agriculture in 2023?
How much did crop production in Sokoto shrink in real terms between 2020 and 2023?
In Sokoto's 2025 multidimensional poverty survey, how many households were interviewed in each sampled enumeration area?
What score on the facility readiness assessment must Tier 2 primary health care facilities reach to be accredited for direct facility financing?
After the first year, what share of previously accredited BEmONC facilities will the independent verification agent visit, and what share of newly accredited ones?
What is the total cost of the health sector activities Sokoto planned for 2025?
Kashi nawa ne na tattalin arzikin (GDP) jihar Sokoto ya fito daga noma a shekarar 2023?
